'''Wakabunga''' (Wurgabunga) is an [[language death|extinct]] and probably unattested [[Australian Aboriginal languages|Australian Aboriginal language]] of [[Queensland]]. The one word list<ref>{{Citation |last=Urquhart |first=F. V. |title=Seymour, Templeton, and Cloncurry Rivers |date=1886 |work=The Australian Race |volume=II |pages=326–329 |url=https://aiatsis.gov.au/sites/default/files/e_access/r_book/curr/pdfs/m0050085_a.pdf |access-date=2025-06-25 |place=Melbourne |publisher=John Ferres, Government Printer}}</ref> labeled as 'Wakabunga' by some is considered by other sources to be of [[Kalkatungu language|Kalkatungu]]. It is commonly classified with [[Wagaya language|Wagaya]] and [[Warluwarra language|Warluwarra]].<ref name="AIATSIS" />
